Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step (Step 4). Although the Planner correctly identified the lifespans of both individuals (Edward Dearle: ~85 years, 1806–1891; Michael Döberl: ~67 years, 1861–1928), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Michael Döberl lived longer. The error lies in failing to calculate the difference between the two lifespans. Since 85 years is greater than 67 years, Edward Dearle actually lived longer. The Planner mistakenly prioritized the later death date (1928 vs 1891) over the total duration of life, leading to the wrong final answer.
